intro.title: Build reusable notification and toast manager
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable notification and toast manager using JavaScript. You will create a system that can display temporary alert messages (toasts) on a webpage, such as success or error notifications. The core programming concept you'll learn is managing state and using functions to control UI updates dynamically. You'll work with JavaScript functions, DOM manipulation, and CSS for styling to make the notifications appear and disappear automatically. By the end, you'll have a flexible component that can be easily integrated into any web project.
intro.usecase: Notification systems are essential in modern web applications to communicate status updates and user feedback. You'll see toast notifications in e-commerce sites confirming successful purchases, in banking apps showing transaction alerts, and in collaboration tools indicating new messages. As a developer, you'll implement these reusable components to handle success messages, error alerts, and system notifications across dashboards, forms, and user interfaces. This pattern allows consistent user experience while keeping your code DRY and maintainable.
